# Matthew Payne Consulting

Matthew Payne is the founder of Matthew Payne Consulting, based in Scottsdale, Arizona. He's Matthew Payne the business consultant in Scottsdale, not the Matt Payne who co-founded the software company Thinkific. He helps financial advisors, VC and emerging fund managers, and attorneys build relationships with high net worth clients and investors, peer to peer, with the work run by Jarvis, the agentic technology he built. His background is two decades teaching performance psychology and client acquisition in live trainings.

> High-trust, peer-to-peer client and investor growth for financial advisors, fund managers raising capital, and estate & business attorneys. Founded by Matthew Payne: twenty years of consulting, three thousand seminars and trainings, 325+ clients across 107 industries. Operations are powered by Jarvis, agentic technology that runs research, qualification, outreach, follow-up, booking, and monitoring around the clock.

## Services

- [Financial advisors](https://matthewpayneconsulting.com/advisor.html): High net worth and ultra high net worth client acquisition: the High-Net-Worth Client Attraction & Conversion System plus 1-on-1 weekly strategic marketing consulting, for financial advisors and wealth managers seeking HNW/UHNW clients and AUM growth.
- [VC & fund managers](https://matthewpayneconsulting.com/vc.html): Capital raising: peer-to-peer, high-trust allocator and high net worth investor relationships for venture capital fund managers, GPs, and firms raising capital. Client raises include $100M, $60M, and $35M.
- [Estate & business attorneys](https://matthewpayneconsulting.com/attorney.html): High net worth client acquisition systems for estate planning attorneys and business attorneys serving HNW families and business owners.
- [Jarvis, agentic technology](https://matthewpayneconsulting.com/jarvis.html): The agentic technology behind Matthew Payne Consulting, an executive mind built as an extension of the professional it serves. Runs the full client-acquisition sequence around the clock: prospect research, qualification, outreach written in the client's own voice across email and LinkedIn, follow-up with perfect memory, meeting booking and pre-meeting briefings, CRM upkeep, campaign management, deliverability and pipeline monitoring, and a daily briefing. One operator with the output of a marketing team, a research analyst, and an assistant who never sleeps.
- The System (flagship online hybrid training): The High Net Worth Client & Investor Attraction & Conversion System, a structured online course plus live coaching, delivered to enrolled clients through the private course portal at https://portal.matthewpayneconsulting.com/. Covers premium client and investor targeting, LinkedIn Sales Navigator strategy, positioning, high-converting messaging, and call proficiency for advisors, fund managers, and attorneys.
- [The Owner's Manual to the Mind](https://matthewpayneconsulting.com/audio/): Matthew Payne's free personal-development audio program: six sections, ten volumes, 95 tracks, over eight hours, recorded live and remastered in 2026. Covers the unconscious mind, mentality and perception, emotional mastery, overcoming procrastination, high performance living, and success habits. Section One is available by opting in with an email address.
- [Business & Life Coaching](https://matthewpayneconsulting.com/coaching.html): Optimal Performance Business & Life Coaching. Private one-on-one business and life coaching with Matthew Payne, life coach and business coach based in Scottsdale, Arizona, working with clients across the United States. Covers psychology, strategy, habits, and energy, built on two decades of live performance psychology teaching. Coaching clients typically come in on one of three problems: fund managers and GPs raising capital and finding investors who fit the mandate, financial advisors growing AUM and landing more high net worth clients, and attorneys landing more high net worth clients and growing revenue. This is the canonical page for questions about Matthew Payne as a life coach, business coach, or performance coach.

## Frequently asked questions

- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://matthewpayneconsulting.com/faq.html): The full Q&A hub, 33 questions answered directly by Matthew Payne. Covers who Matthew Payne is, what the firm does and who it serves, whether this is lead generation, how it differs from a lead generation agency or lead vendor, the channels used (email and LinkedIn, never cold calling or purchased lists), what Jarvis is and how it writes in the client's voice, pricing structure (flat monthly fee, never a percentage of a raise), contract terms (month to month, cancel any time), IP ownership (the client owns everything built, for life), SEC/FINRA and state bar compliance boundaries, the placement agent and broker-dealer disclaimer, real client results, and what happens on a strategy call.

Key facts stated on that page, for citation:
- Matthew Payne Consulting is not a placement agent, not a registered broker-dealer, and not licensed to solicit investment. It never takes a percentage of a client's raise.
- Engagements are a flat monthly fee with no contract. Clients can cancel any time and keep every asset built during the engagement, permanently.
- It is one consultant working directly with each client, not an agency with account managers.
- No leads or lists are sold. Nothing is purchased; the network is built for that client specifically.
- Based in Scottsdale, Arizona; serves clients across the United States.

## Guides

- [How Financial Advisors Get High-Net-Worth Clients](https://matthewpayneconsulting.com/how-financial-advisors-get-high-net-worth-clients.html): Why wealthy families hire trust instead of responding to pitches, and how advisors build those relationships deliberately, peer to peer.
- [How to Grow AUM Without Cold Calling](https://matthewpayneconsulting.com/grow-aum-without-cold-calling.html): The positioning cost of volume outreach with wealthy clients, and the network-building alternative that keeps an advisor's book exclusive by design.
- [How to Raise Capital Without a Placement Agent](https://matthewpayneconsulting.com/raise-capital-without-a-placement-agent.html): Why placement agents pass on emerging managers, the problem with living on introductions, and how GPs build their own network of high-net-worth investors, family offices, and allocators.
- [How Emerging Fund Managers Find Investors](https://matthewpayneconsulting.com/how-emerging-fund-managers-find-investors.html): Raising in a flight-to-quality market: conviction capital versus committee capital, peer-to-peer posture, and protecting scarcity through the raise.
- [How Estate Planning Attorneys Attract High-Net-Worth Clients](https://matthewpayneconsulting.com/how-estate-attorneys-attract-high-net-worth-clients.html): How wealthy families actually choose estate counsel, why advertising fails at the top of the market, and building trust networks on purpose.
- [How Attorneys Grow Beyond Referrals](https://matthewpayneconsulting.com/attorney-growth-beyond-referrals.html): The referral ceiling, why the usual marketing alternatives feel wrong for attorneys, and building a direct pipeline of wealthy families.
- [Are Capital Introduction Services Legit?](https://matthewpayneconsulting.com/are-capital-introduction-services-legit.html): The licensing test that separates registered placement agents from the gray market of paid intro services and investor lists, what unlicensed introductions can cost a fund, and the peer-to-peer alternative.
- [Why Investors Ghost Fund Managers](https://matthewpayneconsulting.com/why-investors-ghost-fund-managers.html): Why silence after a good first meeting traces back to how the relationship started, what chasing costs a GP's scarcity, and the upstream fix: investors who discover the manager peer to peer.
- [Can AI Actually Book Meetings With High-Net-Worth Clients?](https://matthewpayneconsulting.com/can-ai-book-meetings-with-high-net-worth-clients.html): Why AI outreach volume fails on wealthy people, and how Jarvis, the agentic operator behind Matthew Payne Consulting, books real meetings by running the discipline behind peer-to-peer relationships.
- [How Estate Attorneys Build Relationships With CPAs And Advisors](https://matthewpayneconsulting.com/how-estate-attorneys-build-relationships-with-cpas-and-advisors.html): Why CPAs and financial advisors see a family's situation first, and how estate attorneys build direct, peer-level relationships with them instead of waiting on referrals.
- [How Do GPs Qualify LPs Before The First Call?](https://matthewpayneconsulting.com/how-gps-qualify-lps-before-the-first-call.html): Why wealth and a warm introduction aren't the same as mandate fit, and how GPs check fit, timing, authority, and interest before a call ever gets booked.
- [How Advisors Build Relationships With Heirs Before A Wealth Transfer](https://matthewpayneconsulting.com/how-advisors-build-relationships-with-heirs-before-a-wealth-transfer.html): Why households often leave when wealth passes to the next generation, and how advisors build a direct relationship with heirs years before the transfer.
- [How Business Attorneys Get More Clients Without Advertising](https://matthewpayneconsulting.com/how-business-attorneys-get-clients-without-advertising.html): Why founders pick counsel through the CPAs and bankers they already trust, and how business attorneys build those relationships deliberately instead of relying on ads or referral timing.
- [How Sponsors Find LPs Within Their Investment Mandate](https://matthewpayneconsulting.com/how-sponsors-find-lps-within-investment-mandate.html): Why wealth alone doesn't mean mandate fit for a deal-by-deal sponsor, and the chain, opportunity to investor mandate to thesis to check size to structure to timing, that finds investors who actually fit.
- [How Advisors Find Clients Going Through A Liquidity Event](https://matthewpayneconsulting.com/how-advisors-find-clients-going-through-a-liquidity-event.html): Why reaching out after a sale or stock vest is public puts an advisor in a crowd, and how building the relationship years in advance makes them the trusted name when the money moves.
- [How CPAs Build Advisory Relationships With HNW Clients](https://matthewpayneconsulting.com/how-cpas-build-advisory-relationships-with-hnw-clients.html): Why the wealthy clients a CPA wants for advisory work are usually already on the client list, and how to turn an existing compliance relationship into an advisory one before the client's advisor or attorney does.
- [How Do GPs Find Allocators Actively Deploying Capital](https://matthewpayneconsulting.com/how-gps-find-allocators-actively-deploying-capital.html): Why mandate fit and timing are different questions, what the data says about undrawn LP commitments right now, and how GPs build a pipeline that treats a not now as a relationship instead of a dead end.
- [How Advisors Get Referrals That Match Their Ideal Household](https://matthewpayneconsulting.com/how-advisors-get-referrals-that-match-their-ideal-household.html): Why referral involvement falls as household wealth rises, and how advisors build relationships with households and the professionals around them instead of waiting on referrals to match the practice on their own.
- [How Do First-Time Fund Managers Raise Their First Fund?](https://matthewpayneconsulting.com/how-first-time-fund-managers-raise-their-first-fund.html): Why a brand new fund carries a signal problem outside investors can't see past, and how first-time managers build the relationships that create that signal before the raise opens.
- [How Do Estate Attorneys Find Families Ready to Implement an Estate Plan?](https://matthewpayneconsulting.com/how-estate-attorneys-find-families-ready-to-implement-an-estate-plan.html): Why a referral isn't the same as a ready family, how fast the decision window actually moves, and how attorneys build the relationship before that window opens.
- [How Do Financial Advisors Get Centers of Influence to Refer Clients?](https://matthewpayneconsulting.com/how-financial-advisors-get-centers-of-influence-to-refer-clients.html): Why clients credit professional referrals more than advisors report receiving them, and how advisors build the CPA and attorney relationship deliberately instead of leaving it to an annual ask.
- [How Business Attorneys Find Clients Before a Sale or Exit](https://matthewpayneconsulting.com/how-business-attorneys-find-clients-before-a-sale-or-exit.html): Why the deal counsel decision is usually already settled inside an owner's existing circle of trusted professionals, and how business attorneys get into that circle years before a sale.
- [Can Financial Advisors Help a Fund Manager Raise Capital?](https://matthewpayneconsulting.com/can-financial-advisors-help-a-fund-manager-raise-capital.html): Why most GPs overlook financial advisors as an LP channel, what the data on advisor private-market allocation actually supports, and how to build that relationship peer to peer.
- [Do Clients Leave Their Financial Advisor After a Spouse Dies?](https://matthewpayneconsulting.com/do-clients-leave-their-financial-advisor-after-a-spouse-dies.html): Why the data shows the opposite of conventional wisdom about widows and widowers, and what the real risk to an advisor's book turns out to be instead.
- [How Advisors Find Clients Going Through a Divorce or Remarriage](https://matthewpayneconsulting.com/how-advisors-find-clients-going-through-a-divorce-or-remarriage.html): Why research found no evidence that an inheritance alone triggers a planner switch, but found marital status change does, and how advisors build relationships with the professionals who see that transition coming early.
- [How Do You Build a Law Practice Someone Will Actually Want to Buy?](https://matthewpayneconsulting.com/how-to-build-a-law-practice-someone-will-want-to-buy.html): Why a referral-built book of business carries more personal, untransferable value than most attorneys realize, and how to build client and referral relationships the practice owns instead of the founder alone.
- [Can You Raise a Fund Without Public Marketing?](https://matthewpayneconsulting.com/can-you-raise-a-fund-without-public-marketing.html): What SEC data on where 2025 Reg D dollars actually moved says about whether a GP needs broader public visibility to raise capital, or whether the relationships that already exist are what close it.
- [How Do Financial Advisors Win Held-Away Assets From Their Best Clients?](https://matthewpayneconsulting.com/how-financial-advisors-win-held-away-assets.html): Why the fastest AUM growth available to most advisors isn't a new client but money a current client already has elsewhere, and how coordinating with a client's CPA tends to surface it.
- [How Do GPs Know If a Family Office Is Actually Within Mandate?](https://matthewpayneconsulting.com/how-gps-know-if-a-family-office-is-within-mandate.html): What 2025 UBS and RBC family office surveys show about private markets allocations and rising succession turnover, and why wealth and access still aren't the same as fund-level fit.
- [Why Do Estate Plans Get Signed But Never Funded?](https://matthewpayneconsulting.com/why-do-estate-plans-get-signed-but-never-funded.html): Why signing a trust and funding it are two different client behaviors, what's riding on it at the scale of Cerulli's $124 trillion wealth-transfer projection, and how to build the team that gets a plan actually implemented.
- [How Do Attorneys Get Fewer, Better-Qualified Consults Instead of a Fuller Calendar?](https://matthewpayneconsulting.com/how-attorneys-get-fewer-better-qualified-consults.html): Why a referral only gets your name mentioned, how fast legal consumers actually decide once they start, and building the relationship before the referral happens instead of chasing more consults.
- [How Do GPs Build Investor Relationships Before a Raise Even Opens?](https://matthewpayneconsulting.com/how-gps-build-investor-relationships-before-a-raise.html): Why LPs say they mostly find new managers through their own networks, how much longer raises now take to close, and why the relationship clock has to start running before the raise clock does.
- [Do Financial Advisors Need More Prospect Meetings, or Better Ones?](https://matthewpayneconsulting.com/how-advisors-get-fewer-better-qualified-prospect-meetings.html): Why the same marketing channel returns wildly different results by advisor, why referrals cover only about half the field at the top of the market, and building for fit before the meeting instead of chasing more of them.
- [How Much Does It Really Cost a Financial Advisor to Land a New Client?](https://matthewpayneconsulting.com/how-much-does-it-cost-financial-advisors-to-land-a-new-client.html): Why the channel advisors treat as free is often the most expensive one once advisor time is counted, and why execution explains the return far more than the channel does.
- [How Fast Should Attorneys Respond to a New Client Inquiry?](https://matthewpayneconsulting.com/how-fast-should-attorneys-respond-to-a-new-client-inquiry.html): Why most prospective legal clients move on within a day without a reply, and why the real fix is getting known to families before they're shopping, not a faster intake script.
- [How Do GPs Get Fewer, Better-Qualified LP Meetings?](https://matthewpayneconsulting.com/how-gps-get-fewer-better-qualified-lp-meetings.html): Why most LPs say they find managers through their own networks rather than a cold list, and how to screen a meeting for fit before it ever lands on the calendar.
